payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the DFN model on the RACE dataset, detailing the percentage increases over previous models.

claims.text: DFN achieves a 7.8% performance boost over GA and a 7.3% boost over Stanford AR on RACE-M.
On RACE-H, DFN outperforms previous models by 1.5% and 2.7%.
Ensemble models using DFN also show a performance boost of 4-5% compared to previous methods.
